settings.heading: A hotel bed,
settings.text: Elovela is a UK sleep and comfort brand making pillows, mattress toppers, protectors and support pillows that bring the feeling of a hotel bed home. We’re honest about what’s inside, easy to care for, and delivered free across the UK.

settings.image_alt: Hands smoothing an Elovela mattress protector over a bed

settings.title: Soft by design
settings.text: Every product starts with how it feels: plump fills, smooth covers and quilting that keeps its shape.

settings.title: Honest inside
settings.text: We tell you exactly what’s in it — the fill, the fabric, the size — and never promise more than a pillow can do.

settings.title: Care built in
settings.text: Machine-washable fills and covers, so keeping your bed fresh is easy.

settings.title: Fair to every home
settings.text: Hotel-quality comfort for every home, without the big spend.

settings.title: Refreshing a tired bed
settings.text: A Cloud Topper adds 10cm of even softness — no new mattress needed.

settings.title: Expecting, or newly nursing
settings.text: U and V-shape pillows that hold you, from bump to baby.

settings.title: Sleeping with allergies
settings.text: Hypoallergenic fills and 100% waterproof protectors, with every material stated plainly.

settings.text: Free UK delivery on every order, and help at any hour.
